notes.title: Wind of Change and Pawprints: Update Chronicles
notes.content:
[p][i]Greetings, Seeker… It’s me again — Nox. If you smelled burnt magic or heard the whisper of shifting code — you’re not wrong. Some things were broken… now, less so. Some things were missing… now, present. And some things — still secret (for now).[/i][/p][p][i]A few of you couldn't hatch your dragons due to regional hiccups — but worry not, the egg-lights shine again. I’ve seen it with my own two eyes.[/i][/p][p][i]And since I was already out and about, I stopped by the workshops, the UI vaults, and the circle of updates... Here’s what changed — seen and unseen.

[/i][b]☽ [u]Bug Fixes[/u][i]:[/i][/b][/p][p]
✦ Fixed an issue that prevented character creation in some regions.[/p][p]
✦ Fixed a bug where deleting one character could accidentally remove others.[/p][p]
✦ Fixed early gliding access — no soaring before you earn your wings![/p][p]
✦ Updates & Changes:[/p][p]
✦ Complete overhaul of character animation and movement feel.[/p][p]
✦ New camera angle, now with zoom in/out ability.[/p][p]
✦ Quest system reworked, transitioning toward a new full narrative structure.[/p][p]
✦ Updated gliding attempt animation — more personality![/p][p]
✦ Character creation interface enhanced, and still evolving.[/p][p]
✦ World optimization — smoother than a polished scale.[/p][p]
[b]☽ [u]Added[/u]:[/b][/p][p]
✦ Additional hotbar for quick skill/item use.[/p][p]
✦ Emotes added — check “Special” in your inventory.[/p][p]
✦ New abilities added (hidden until your dragon earns the level to awaken them).[/p][p]
✦ [b]Gliding and Fall Protection:[/b][/p][p]
[b]~[/b] [i]Did you know that young dragons are capable of more than just face-planting into the ground?[/i][/p][p][i]Now, when leaping from great heights — hold \[Ctrl], and your wings will unfurl into a graceful glide.[/i][/p][p][i]This is called gliding, and it will keep your paws safe from fall damage.[/i][/p][p][i]Without it, though… high falls can definitely hurt.[/i][/p][p][i]And believe me — tail-first landings are not as fun as they sound.[/i][/p][p]
[b]☽ [u]Coming Soon[/u]:[/b][/p][p]
✦ Map expansion with new zones.[/p][p]
✦ New inhabitants and dynamic NPCs.[/p][p]
✦ Main questline continues — secrets await.[/p][p]
✦ More quests, new skill branches.[/p][p]
✦ Higher level cap[/p][p]
✦ Entirely new mechanics are in the works...[/p][p]
[b]☽ [u]Behind the Curtains (but real work!)[/u]:[/b][/p][p]
✦ Multiplayer sync restructured for smoother sessions[/p][p]
✦ UI elements modularized for future content[/p][p]
✦ Localization hooks prepared[/p][p]
✦ NPC relationship system framework laid down[/p][p]
✦ Visual effects pipeline rebuilt for future evolution stages[/p][p]
✦ Codebase optimized for better loading in low-end systems[/p][p]
[b][i]That's all... for now. The world is changing, and so are we.[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]If something goes wrong — remember, you're not alone. I'm here.[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]I hear. I see. I whisper... sometimes.[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]Take care, winged one. Until we meet again.[/i][/b][/p][p][i]— Nox, your ever-watchful guide 🐾[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🐾 Nox’s Patch Notes – Fixes & Improvements! 🛠️
notes.content:
Hey, adventurers! It’s your Nox, bringing you some exciting fixes and updates for Ignisia!

📌 What’s fixed and improved?

🐾 🏕️ [b]Tents now work properly![/b]
Your respawn point will now be saved even after re-entering the game or switching channels. No more unexpected teleportation surprises!

🐾 🗺️ [b]Updated UI + Mini-map added![/b]
The mini-map is finally here! Now you’ll always know where to go. Wandering blindly is fun… but knowing your way is even better!

🐾 🎯 [b]Improved target selection![/b]
Selecting enemies and objects is now much smoother, making combat and interactions way more convenient.

🐾 🌐 [b]Replication system reworked![/b]
We’ve improved the networking system and continue refining it to ensure a smoother multiplayer experience.

[i]Thanks for your patience and support! We’re working hard to make Ignisia a better and more enjoyable place for all of you. 🐾[/i]

notes.title: News from Nox: Fixes and Updates 🐾
notes.content:
[b]Dear friends, thank you for your patience![/b]

[b]We’re excited to announce that we’ve fixed the main replication issue:[/b] 

all items, quests, and progress are now stored on the client side, not just on the host. Any experience and achievements gained on other channels will no longer be lost.

To temporarily address the issue of quest hand-ins for channel clients, we’ve added purple projections for completing quests. Now, you can submit quests nearby without returning to the NPC who issued them. Your experience, rewards, and progress are preserved as they should be. We’re working hard to improve the quest system to make it more seamless for you.

[b]Tents:[/b]

Thank you for your feedback! We’ve fixed the issue where the restoration point was only saved by the host. Now, clients and hosts have separate restoration saves. However, please note: tent saves are not yet carried over when switching or re-entering a channel. Make sure to approach tents to set your restoration point again.

[b]Other updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added icons to the skills window.
[*] Improved replication for multiplayer functionality.
[/list]

[b]Telegram Channel:[/b]
We’ve also launched our Telegram channel, where we’ll share development progress and updates. [u][b]Join us to stay informed about what’s coming next[/b][/u]:

[https://t.me/Ignisia_world]

[i][b]Thank you[/b], your support helps make Ignisiya a cozy and comfortable world for everyone[/i]

notes.title: 🐑 Hotfix: Sheep are back in action!
notes.content: Fixed an issue where sheep refused to drop items and grant experience. They are now behaving as intended and generously providing rewards. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: 🛠️ Hotfix for Travel Tents is Now Available!
notes.content:
Meow-meow, brave adventurers! 🐾 It's me, Nox, with some important updates.

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] We discovered an issue where travel tents stopped functioning properly after accepting the quest "Descent into the Unknown" and couldn't be set as respawn points until the quest was completed. Now the tents are working as intended, no matter the quest's progress.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and support! If you notice anything else, meow-meow, please let us know through the feedback form in the game menu.

[i]See you in the magical world of Ignisia! ✨
Yours truly,
Nox 🐾[/i]

notes.title: Nox here: What's new in Ignisia? 🐾
notes.content:
[i]Meow-meow, my brave adventurers!
It’s me again, your little kitten Nox. Today I bring you news from Ignisia. Let’s see what’s changed:[/i]

[b]Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*] No more magic spoilers! Previously, your character could accidentally reveal their final form with mastered magic right in the editor—even though they hadn’t learned it yet! Awkward, right? Now everything is as it should be: your hero will show their true form only after completing their initiation.

[*] Fixed an issue where a test interface occasionally appeared on active buttons. Everything should now work smoothly!
[/list]

[b]Added[/b]

[list]
[*] Portable tents: Convenient tents have appeared in the world of Ignisia. Marked with special symbols on the mini-map, you can interact with them to select your respawn point. Return here after teleportation or if you fall in battle. Remember, this feature is still experimental, so let us know if anything goes wrong!

[*] Feedback system: A Google form has been added directly to the game menu. If you have thoughts, ideas, or notice something strange, share them with me there!

[*] Control hints: We’ve added hints for some controls that weren’t explained before. Everything is now easier and more intuitive!
[/list]

[b]A gift from Nox: [/b]

[list]
[*] As a token of my gratitude for your support and patience, I’ve prepared a little gift. Come meet me at the waterfall—but don’t delay, I’ll only be there for one day!
[/list]

[b]Temporary Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Mini-map disabled: To reduce system load, we’ve temporarily disabled its display. Quest markers and icons are still functional. And about the big world map... meow-meow, it’s in development! Can you imagine? One day, you’ll be able to see the entire world of Ignisia at a glance. But for now, I can’t say when that will happen.
[/list]

[b]Plans[/b]

[list]
[*] Game interface improvements: We’re working to make the interface take up less game space while remaining easily accessible and non-distracting for your adventures.

[*] Player communication: Our Discord and Telegram are coming soon. We want to make it easier for you to connect with each other—and with us.

[*] Game chat improvements: We’re actively working to make the chat more comfortable and enjoyable to use.

[*] Emotions for interactions: More ways to express emotions will be added in the future.

[*] Experiments with features: We’ll continue trying new ideas to make the game even more comfortable and engaging.

[*] Kaelin on guard: All disruptors of peace have been dealt with, and order has been restored. But the tranquility of Ignisia remains under her watchful eye.

[*] Major content update: Once we polish the current version of the game, I’ll prepare a big, exciting update for you. Stay tuned, meow!
[/list]

[i]Thank You for Your Support![/i]

⚠️ [b][i]Meow, don’t forget: the game is still in alpha. This means it’s a work in progress, and we welcome your participation, feedback, and ideas.

Thank you for your trust and patience! Ignisia will become even better with your help. And I, Nox, will always be here to guide you through it all.

See you in the world of magic!
Your Nox 🐾[/i][/b]

notes.title: Greetings from Nox, Your Fluffy Companion! 🐾
notes.content:
Meow, friends! It’s me, Nox — your loyal companion in the world of Ignisia. Today, I have something important to share with you.

Ignisia is opening its doors! Early Access: the alpha version of the game is now available, and you can dive into this wonderful world. Of course, the work is still ongoing, but we’re confident that, together with you, we’ll make Ignisia even better.

⚠️ [b]Here’s what you need to know:[/b]

[list]
[*] The game world is just beginning to take shape, so some parts are still under development.
[*] Not all features are active yet, but they will be soon. Patience, purr!
[*] Everything you see now is just the start of a long journey, where things can change and improve.
[/list]

[b]What’s available now?[/b]

[list]
[*] The chance to explore Ignisia and try out the basic mechanics.
[*] An opportunity to share your feedback and help us make the game better — your input is priceless to us!
[/list]

[b]What’s coming next?[/b]
As soon as we handle all the launch essentials, we promise to develop our social media too. You’ll be able to peek behind the scenes of development and learn more about our world and me, Nox.

Thank you for being with us! Together, we’re creating something truly special. If you happen to see me in the game, don’t forget to give me a little pet — I’m always happy to see you. 🐾

See you in Ignisia!
— [i]Your Nox, humble guardian and fluffy observer.[/i]
